sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, sitting comfortably at the top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, travel to Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October 2026 (KO 15:00). The league leaders are in excellent form with five consecutive wins before a recent draw, and they face a struggling Alsager side near the foot of the table with just 4 points from 10 games.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host Dawley Town in a match that could have title-race implications, with Stafford looking to close the two-point gap on leaders Sandbach. AFC Bridgnorth (3rd, 19 points) travel to Eccleshall (5th, 18 points) in a direct battle between high-flying sides, while Wolverhampton Casuals at home to Wednesfield Community offers another clash between mid-table contenders. Bilston Town (6th) entertain Foley Meir in a fixture between the upper-middle reaches of the table. At the other end, Crewe host Allscott Heath in a basement battle, Cheadle Heath Nomads face Telford Town (two of the division's weakest sides), and Shawbury United welcome Barnton. Brereton Social visit Widnes Town, who remain pointless after 7 matches, while Market Drayton Town travel to New Mills.
